dedupe_keys.name: operation scada dataset of an urban small wind turbine in sao paulo brazil

description: The University of São Paulo publishes operational observations from a Skystream 3.7 small wind turbine on its High Voltage Laboratory roof. Annual CSV files cover 2017–2022 at one-minute intervals, with a text data dictionary. Recorded quantities include energy, voltage, current, frequency, rotation, wind speed and temperatures, together with inverter alarms and status flags. Zenodo supplies the files freely under CC BY 4.0. The measurements can calibrate urban wind-generation simulations and test condition-monitoring methods. Coverage is limited to one rooftop installation, and status integers can combine several bit-coded causes, so they require the documented decoding. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Operation SCADA Dataset of an Urban Small Wind Turbine in São Paulo, Brazil
notes: G4-0298; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
